versions.changelog:
guaikei-xhs-public-data-tool v1.0.0

- Initial release with comprehensive support for Xiaohongshu public data retrieval and structuring.
- Automatically routes user input to the correct command based on Xiaohongshu link type or keyword.
- Supports four main functions: keyword search, note detail (with comments), creator post list, and comments only.
- Robust input validation, error handling, and clear user guidance built in.
- No account login required; strictly public/open data only.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for operation.
